programs.name: Summer Internship Program in Biomedical Research (SIP)
programs.focus: The largest biomedical summer research program in the country. One application reaches hundreds of NIH intramural labs across every institute, including NICHD (pediatrics), NINDS (neuro) and NCI (cancer).
programs.stipend_note: Stipend scales with education level; housing not provided

eligibility.notes: US citizens or permanent residents, enrolled at least half time. Must be 17 by program start.

programs.notes: HIGHEST PRIORITY. One application reaches an enormous number of labs, and you can email individual PIs directly to improve your odds — that outreach is what actually gets people placed. The 2026 cycle closed Feb 18; 2027 is expected to open mid-November 2026 and close mid-February 2027. Verify at training.nih.gov/sip.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it — open it in a browser.

programs.name: Amgen Scholars Program (US)
programs.city: Multiple (Caltech, Columbia, Duke, Harvard, Hopkins, UCLA, UCSF, UNC, UT Southwestern, WashU, Yale and more)
programs.focus: Premier national undergraduate research program with a shared symposium; each host institution runs its own application and its own labs.
programs.stipend_note: Varies by host; most include housing and travel

eligibility.notes: Sophomores, juniors, or non-graduating seniors at accredited four-year schools. Minimum 3.2 cumulative GPA. Oriented toward students interested in a PhD or MD-PhD.

programs.notes: BEST VALUE PER UNIT OF EFFORT. You can apply to as many US hosts as you like, and much of the essay content is reusable across them. Applications open Nov 1, 2026. CONFIRMED on the page: Feb 1, 2027 for all US hosts.
programs.program_dates: Varies by host, roughly May 17 – Aug 27, 2027

programs.name: Summer Student Program (SSP)
programs.city: Bar Harbor, ME and Farmington, CT
programs.focus: Ten weeks of genetics and genomics research with an independent project and a written report — unusually strong mentorship structure.

eligibility.notes: High school seniors and undergraduates. Deadline is 5:00 p.m. ET.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED DATE: Jan 25, 2027 at 5pm ET. Best total compensation package on this whole list — stipend plus room, board and travel. Applications open November 2026.

programs.name: Summer Research Early Identification Program (SR-EIP)
programs.city: Multiple member institutions (Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Harvard, Hopkins, Yale, Vanderbilt and more)
programs.focus: One application, many elite host institutions, plus a national research symposium at the end of the summer.
programs.stipend_note: Varies by host; travel and housing typically covered

eligibility.notes: Must have at least one semester remaining after the program.

programs.notes: Like Amgen, one application maps to many institutions. Opens Nov 1. Recent cycles closed in early February (Feb 3, 2025; Feb 1 listed by several campuses for 2027). CONFIRMED on the page: Feb 3, 2027, and the deadline covers the whole package including two letters and official transcripts.

programs.name: Broad Summer Research Program (BSRP)
programs.org: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
programs.focus: Nine weeks of genomics, cancer and neuroscience research at one of the strongest genomics institutes in the world.
programs.stipend_note: $5,400 plus free housing at partner university facilities and travel to/from Boston

eligibility.notes: Must be available for the entire nine weeks. The Broad said 2027 eligibility criteria would be updated in October 2026 — check now.

programs.notes: 2026 cycle closed Jan 11 with letters due Jan 13. A third-party listing shows an anticipated 1/11/27. Early deadline — do not let this one slip behind the February cluster.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
programs.focus: Independent research in basic and cancer biology at Fred Hutch.
programs.stipend_note: Approximately $7,304 plus up to $450 travel allowance

eligibility.notes: RISING SENIORS ONLY — you must be entering the summer before your final year of undergrad. That is exactly this year.

programs.notes: PERFECT TIMING FIT: restricted to rising seniors, which is precisely your junior summer. The 2026 deadline was Jan 9. Fred Hutch said 2027 info posts in November. Early deadline — do it in the December block.

programs.name: Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
programs.focus: Ten fully subsidized weeks of research at a legendary molecular biology institute, ending in a formal presentation.
programs.stipend_note: $6,000 for personal expenses; accommodation and meals largely covered. Travel not reimbursed.

eligibility.notes: Sophomores and juniors. First-year students considered only in exceptional cases.

programs.notes: Deadline has been Jan 15 in both 2025 and 2026, so mid-January 2027 is a safe planning assumption. Enormous prestige for a PhD-track application.

programs.name: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
programs.focus: Nine weeks of research in MIT labs with heavy graduate-school preparation.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend plus housing, travel and meal allowance

eligibility.notes: Oriented toward students planning a PhD.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of bench research at a pure-research biomedical institute with an excellent mentoring reputation.

programs.name: REU Sites — Biological Sciences (search portal)
programs.focus: The master index of NSF-funded Research Experiences for Undergraduates. Each site applies separately; stipends are standardized and housing is usually covered.

eligibility.notes: NSF REUs require US citizenship or permanent residency. Most exclude graduating seniors.

programs.notes: Not one program but a portal to hundreds. Filter by Biological Sciences and by state. Deadlines run from December to March, so check it monthly. Housing and travel are usually covered, which makes REUs cheaper than many hospital programs.

programs.name: Pathways to Science — summer research database
programs.focus: The best free aggregator of funded undergraduate summer research programs, searchable by discipline and deadline.
programs.notes: Use this as a monthly sweep to catch programs this list does not have. Sort by deadline.

programs.name: Summer Health Professions Education Program (SHPEP)
programs.org: Robert Wood Johnson Foundation (multiple host schools)
programs.focus: Free summer enrichment at academic health centers — clinical exposure, MCAT and admissions prep rather than bench research.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend plus housing and meals, no cost to attend

eligibility.notes: Primarily freshmen and sophomores — likely TOO EARLY for a rising senior, listed for completeness.

programs.notes: Aimed at freshmen and sophomores, so almost certainly too early for a rising senior — listed so the set is honest about what exists. Skip it unless you want clinical exposure rather than research.

programs.name: NYSCF Summer Research Internship
programs.focus: Stem cell and neurodegeneration research in NYC.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED: Mar 15, 2027, program runs Jun 7 - Aug 13, 2027. Valuable as a LATE deadline — a real second chance if February brings rejections.
